note: Schema 1 recorded every non-PSX guest as mode 'native-bridge' against /dev/native0 guest kinds. That bridge does not exist in PowerEngine and has been removed; see the 'Removed: the native-bridge mock' section of docs/VIRTUA_PLATFORM.md. Each guest now reaches the device by one of two real routes, chosen by whether the guest CPU is the host CPU.

modes.static-recompilation: guest CPU is not ARMv7; guest code is translated to C ahead of time and compiled for Cortex-A7
modes.direct-execution: guest CPU is ARMv7, same as the host; guest instructions run untranslated and the guest's OS is reimplemented around them (the WINE model)

gba.note: Studio drives this automatically; the previous 'Native' checkbox and its /dev/native0 launcher are gone.

vita.pkg_reader: header, metadata records and item table are decrypted with the format's own published key: key type at 0xE4, types 2-4 derive the AES-128-CTR key by ECB-encrypting the package riv, type 1 uses the key directly. The key is only accepted when the decrypted item table is self-consistent (offsets inside the data area, printable ASCII names). Yields the item list, sce_sys/param.sfo and the plaintext sce_pfs/pflist.
vita.pkg_blocked_at: sce_pfs — a file whose pflist mark is empty is stored PFS-encrypted, and the PFS key comes from the licence (work.bin / zRIF), which a package does not contain. The refusal names pflist as the evidence and eboot.bin as the file it wanted.
vita.sample_result: opens: 103 items, content id EP4040-PCSB00405_00-TERRARIA00000001, param.sfo Terraria / PCSB00405 / gd / 01.00, 78 PFS-protected files; blocked at sce_pfs because eboot.bin is one of them

horizon.nsp_reader_unkeyed: the outer PFS0 partition, the .cnmt.xml content list and the ticket parse with no key at all: title id, content meta type, every NCA in the package, the ticket rights id and title key
horizon.nsp_reader_keyed: the NCA header is AES-128-XTS under header_key with Nintendo's big-endian sector tweak; with a prod.keys present Studio decrypts it, walks the FS headers to the ExeFS PFS0 and stages main
horizon.nsp_blocked_at: header_key, which Nintendo does not publish and which is not in this repo. The refusal names the key and lists the paths searched, after having read the whole unkeyed tier.
horizon.sample_result: opens unkeyed: 7 entries, title id 010080b00ad66000, meta type Application, Program/Control/LegalInformation/Meta contents, rights id 010080b00ad660000000000000000005; blocked at the NCA header for want of header_key. The keyed tier is unverified here because no prod.keys exists on this machine.
horizon.aarch64_note: refused by name; a Cortex-A7 cannot execute AArch64 at all
horizon.ipc: HIPC/CMIF transport complete; sm: implemented, no device services yet
horizon.svc_abi_32bit: derived from the AArch64 ABI, documented as D1/D2/D3 in extra/horizon2mvii/include/horizon_svc.h
